title: Momoi Airi — Even If Just With Words〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well then, let's all think about how we're going to present our gifts before our next meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad that we're on schedule to do this stream before White Day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too! We should be good to go as long as we're able to hammer everything out during our next meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I have a separate question concerning White Day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A separate question?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're presenting possible White Day gifts during our next stream, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But what about our viewers?
What are we gonna get them...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we completely missed that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I have a suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You do, Airi?!
Please, tell us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should make greeting cards for all our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Greeting cards?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, like those templates you told us about the other day?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh oh...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(What are you doing, Minori?!
We haven't sent everyone their invitations yet—)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The other day?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't remember you talking about that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I-I was talking about...! Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A-About when I was in junior high! It came up when we were researching gifts!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was so busy back then that I had to make greeting cards to celebrate special occasions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! There's this cool site with lots of templates that makes it really easy to make nice cards for people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank you so much, Airi...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (For goodness sake...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Greeting cards...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, are you saying that we could make digital ones for them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. For example, we could create a link to a website where they can all download the cards. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I like it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, would someone like me have trouble making one?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: None whatsoever. I'll help you every step of the way until you get the hang of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, calm down.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, get out your phones!
It's time for Ms. Airi's special lesson on making amazing greeting cards!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll start by showing you all some really cool templates!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Thank goodness we were able to do our segment about White Day gifts before the actual day.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (All that's left is to unveil our little surprise!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we want you all to know that we'll be cheering you on this White Day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Another day, another fun stream!>
<I promise to do my best!>
<Thanks for cheering us on!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Have a nice White Day!
Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not so fast!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hm?>
<There's more?>
<What's going on?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It isn't fair for us to talk about all these great gift ideas for White Day and not give you guys anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, it isn't. Right, you two?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Right!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, what?!>
<Huh?! Does that mean...?!>
<No way!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know it isn't actually White Day yet, but we've prepared a special surprise!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We made greeting cards for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll throw the link in the chat in a second! You'll be able to jump over to the site where you can download them♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We each made one as a small token of our appreciation for all the support you've given us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we hope you get a chance to read what we all wrote!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You each made one?!>
<Wait, whoa...>
<Gotta read them all!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The download page will be up from today through White Day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So there's no need to worry if you don't have time to look right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, we'll put the link to that page in the description once this stream's over!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll also send the link in a message, so please access the website by whichever way you prefer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, that's it for today's stream!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
See you next time!
Happy White Day♪

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy White Day♪
